description: Regenerate the 8BD7 interface census, build the evidence matrix and GO decision table artifacts, and produce the final summary figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
PROV='/agent/jobs/45cdd2ff-33f4-48dd-aecb-f650c9ff40d6/provenance/'
print("existing provenance files:", sorted(os.listdir(PROV)))

# verify what PMID 28479320 actually is (do not guess)
es=requests.get("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi",
   params={"db":"pubmed","id":"28479320","retmode":"json"},timeout=60).json()
d=es['result']['28479320']
print("\nPMID 28479320 =", d.get('title'),"|",d.get('fulljournalname'), d.get('pubdate'))

# ---- recompute the subunit census (artifact table) ----
cif=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/8BD7.cif",timeout=300).text.split('\n')
st=next(i for i,l in enumerate(cif) if l.startswith('_atom_site.'))
hdr=[];i=st
while cif[i].startswith('_atom_site.'): hdr.append(cif[i].strip().split('.')[1]); i+=1
rows=[]
while i<len(cif) and not cif[i].startswith('#'):
    p=cif[i].split()
    if len(p)==len(hdr): rows.append(p)
    i+=1
at=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=hdr)
for c in ['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']: at[c]=at[c].astype(float)
at['auth_seq_id']=at['auth_seq_id'].astype(int)
NAME={'A':'IFT88','B':'IFT52','C':'IFT70','D':'IFT46','E':'IFT56','F':'IFT81','G':'IFT74','I':'IFT80',
 'L':'IFT38','M':'IFT57','S':'IFT172','W':'IFT20','X':'IFT54','H':'IFT88','J':'IFT52','K':'IFT70',
 'N':'IFT46','O':'IFT56','P':'IFT81','Q':'IFT74','R':'IFT80','T':'IFT38','U':'IFT57','V':'IFT172','Y':'IFT20','Z':'IFT54'}
SUB={'IFT88':'B1','IFT52':'B1','IFT70':'B1','IFT46':'B1','IFT56':'B1','IFT81':'B1','IFT74':'B1',
     'IFT80':'B2','IFT38':'B2','IFT57':'B2','IFT172':'B2','IFT20':'B2','IFT54':'B2'}
REP={c:(1 if c in list('ABCDEFGILMSWX') else 2) for c in NAME}
chains=[c for c in NAME if c in set(at.auth_asym_id)]
co={c:at[at.auth_asym_id==c][['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']].values for c in chains}
ri={c:at[at.auth_asym_id==c]['auth_seq_id'].values for c in chains}
tr={c:cKDTree(co[c]) for c in chains}
ed=[]
for a in chains:
    for b in chains:
        if a>=b: continue
        pr=tr[a].query_ball_tree(tr[b],5.0)
        ra=set();rb=set()
        for k,l in enumerate(pr):
            if l:
                ra.add(int(ri[a][k]))
                for x in l: rb.add(int(ri[b][x]))
        if ra: ed.append({'cA':a,'cB':b,'A':NAME[a],'B':NAME[b],'nA':len(ra),'nB':len(rb),'lateral':REP[a]!=REP[b]})
E=pd.DataFrame(ed)
cen=[]
for c in [x for x in chains if REP[x]==1]:
    s=E[(E.cA==c)|(E.cB==c)]; intra=s[~s.lateral]; lat=s[s.lateral]
    n=sum(r['nA'] if r['cA']==c else r['nB'] for _,r in intra.iterrows())
    nl=sum(r['nA'] if r['cA']==c else r['nB'] for _,r in lat.iterrows())
    pr=sorted({(r['B'] if r['cA']==c else r['A']) for _,r in intra.iterrows()})
    cen.append({'subunit':NAME[c],'subcomplex':SUB[NAME[c]],'modelled_residues':len(np.unique(ri[c])),
        'n_partners':len(pr),'interface_residues':n,'interface_res_per_100aa':round(100*n/len(np.unique(ri[c])),1),
        'lateral_interface_residues':nl,'partners':','.join(pr)})
C=pd.DataFrame(cen).sort_values('interface_residues',ascending=False)
C.to_csv(PROV+'8BD7_subunit_interface_census.csv',index=False)
E.to_csv(PROV+'8BD7_all_pairwise_interfaces.csv',index=False)
print("\n=== 8BD7 subunit interface census (artifact) ===")
print(C.to_string(index=False))

# ---- GO decision table (artifact) ----
GO=[
 ['GO:0030992','intraciliary transport particle B','CC','part_of','IBA, NAS','RETAIN, strengthen',
  'IFT56 is a genuine subunit of the IFT-B1 module in PDB 8BD7, burying 31 interface residues against IFT46, IFT52 and IFT70. Structural basis now exists for a term previously IBA/NAS only.'],
 ['GO:0120170','intraciliary transport particle B binding','MF','enables','IBA','RETAIN at this specificity',
  'Correct level of granularity. More informative than GO:0005515 protein binding, which should not be introduced. Named partners are IFT46, IFT52, IFT70 by homology transfer.'],
 ['GO:0035720','intraciliary anterograde transport','BP','involved_in','IBA','RETAIN',
  'DYF-13 undergoes IFT in C. elegans (PMID 15916950); IFT56 sits only in anterograde train repeats in 8BD7.'],
 ['GO:0035735','intraciliary transport involved in cilium assembly','BP','involved_in','IBA','RETAIN',
  'Consistent with dyf-13(mn396) ciliary structural defect (PMID 15916950) and Ift56hop cilia defects (PMID 28264835).'],
 ['GO:0036064','ciliary basal body','CC','is_active_in','IBA','FLAG for verification',
  'is_active_in basal body is not supported by any C. elegans datum found here; mammalian TTC26 was localised to the transition zone, not the basal body (PMID 22718903).'],
 ['GO:0097546','ciliary base','CC','is_active_in','IBA','FLAG for verification',
  'Same concern as GO:0036064. Transition zone localisation (PMID 22718903) is a different compartment.'],
 ['GO:0005515','protein binding','MF','enables','not annotated','DO NOT ADD',
  'Uninformative. GO:0120170 already covers the supported binding activity.'],
 ['(none)','protein-complex scaffold / complex assembly terms','MF/BP','-','not annotated','DO NOT ADD',
  'Refuted by structure: IFT56 has the smallest normalised footprint of 13 subunits (5.6 res/100aa vs B1 median 124 residues), betweenness 0.000, not an articulation point, 0 lateral train contacts.'],
]
G=pd.DataFrame(GO,columns=['go_id','go_term','aspect','qualifier','current_evidence','lead_action','rationale'])
G.to_csv(PROV+'GO_decision_table.csv',index=False)
print("\n=== GO decision table (artifact) ===")
print(G[['go_id','go_term','aspect','current_evidence','lead_action']].to_string(index=False))

# ---- evidence matrix (artifact) ----
EV=[
 ['PMID:36593313','structural','supports + qualifies','Which IFT-B subunits IFT56 contacts, and how large the interface is',
  'IFT56 contacts only IFT46 (14 res), IFT70 (10), IFT52 (7) at <5 A; smallest normalised footprint of 13 subunits; betweenness 0.000; no lateral train contacts',
  'Chlamydomonas reinhardtii cilia, in situ cryo-ET 9.9 A with AlphaFold2 models docked (PDB 8BD7)',
  'High for partner identity (reproduced in both repeats); moderate for residue-level detail because side chains are not resolved at 9.9 A'],
 ['PMID:25340710','direct assay / interaction','supports','Does IFT56/TTC26 bind IFT46 directly',
  'Wild-type Ttc26 binds directly to the Ift46 subunit of IFT complex B','Mouse, protein-protein interaction assay',
  'High; independent of the structure and of the organism used for it'],
 ['PMID:27927754','interaction','supports','Do IFT56 and IFT46 form a module',
  'ARL13B interacts with the IFT46-IFT56 dimer of the IFT-B complex','Human cells, visible immunoprecipitation assay',
  'High for the IFT46-IFT56 dimer; the ARL13B link is a separate claim'],
 ['PMID:20923419','interaction','supports + competing','Which partners co-purify with the DYF-13 ortholog',
  'PIFTC3 in a ~660 kDa complex with IFT-B components plus DYF-1 (IFT70), DYF-3, DYF-11, IFTA-2; also co-IP with IFT122 (IFT-A)',
  'Trypanosoma brucei, affinity purification and mass spectrometry','Moderate-high; the IFT122 contact is not reproduced in 8BD7 and may be indirect'],
 ['PMID:26980730','interaction / review-level synthesis','competing','Is TTC26/IFT56 a core or peripheral IFT-B subunit',
  'Assigns TTC26/IFT56 to the salt-resistant IFT-B core subcomplex by visible immunoprecipitation',
  'Human cells, VIP assay','Moderate; biochemical salt-resistance and small structural footprint are compatible, so this qualifies rather than refutes'],
 ['PMID:24596149','mutant phenotype','supports (periphery)','Is IFT56 needed to build or run the IFT train',
  'IFT particle assembly and speed are normal in dyf13 mutant flagella, unlike other IFT-B mutants; motility proteins specifically depleted',
  'Chlamydomonas reinhardtii flagella','High; directly matches the structural prediction that IFT56 is not a scaffold'],
 ['PMID:28264835','mutant phenotype','qualifies','Does IFT56 affect IFT-B composition in cilia',
  'Core IFT-B proteins IFT88, IFT81, IFT27 fail to accumulate in Ift56hop cilia; IFT-A unaffected','Mouse Ift56hop mutant',
  'High for the phenotype; the mechanism is not explained by the three small interfaces in 8BD7'],
 ['PMID:15916950','mutant phenotype / localization','supports (worm-specific)','Is DYF-13 an IFT protein in C. elegans',
  'dyf-13(mn396) ciliary structural defect maps to C27H5.7a; the protein undergoes IFT and its transport is disrupted by ift and bbs mutations',
  'C. elegans ciliated sensory neurons','High; the only direct C. elegans evidence, and it is not represented by any experimental-code GO annotation'],
 ['PMID:22718903','localization','competing','Where does the IFT56 ortholog localise',
  'Ttc26 localised to the transition zone of photoreceptor cilia and of mIMCD3 cilia','Mouse photoreceptor, mIMCD3 cells',
  'Moderate; transition zone differs from the ciliary base and basal body terms currently annotated IBA'],
 ['This work','computational','qualifies','Can convex/concave solenoid geometry place DYF-13 as scaffold or adaptor',
  'No. Arc radius 34.5 A; mapped contacts split 6 concave / 9 convex vs background 218/305, Fisher OR 1.07, p = 1.0',
  'AlphaFold AF-Q95QT8-F1-v6','High as a negative result; refutes this component of the seed hypothesis'],
 ['This work','computational','qualifies','Is the contact transfer to C. elegans independently supported',
  'DYF-6, OSM-6 and DYF-1 exist at 36-48% identity, but their IFT56-binding residues are no better conserved than background (Fisher p = 0.70-1.0)',
  'Chlamydomonas vs C. elegans pairwise alignments','High; means the transfer is orthology-based, not interface-validated'],
 ['This work','computational','qualifies','Does IFT-B account for the conserved surface of DYF-13',
  'No. All 4 conserved exposed patches (45-62, 166-373, 347-357, 378-414) lie outside the mapped contacts; the C-half 325-574 is conserved (0.452) and folded (pLDDT 91.9) yet contacts nothing',
  'AlphaFold model + 10-ortholog alignment','Moderate-high; limited by 9.9 A resolution and by IFT-B2/cargo absent from the modelled repeat'],
]
M=pd.DataFrame(EV,columns=['citation','evidence_type','stance','claim_tested','key_finding','context','confidence_and_limits'])
M.to_csv(PROV+'evidence_matrix.csv',index=False)
print("\n=== Evidence matrix rows:",len(M),"(saved) ===")
print(M[['citation','evidence_type','stance']].to_string(index=False))

# ---- final summary figure ----
per=pd.read_csv(PROV+'dyf13_per_residue.csv')
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7.5),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1,1.25]})
a=ax[0]
cc=C.sort_values('interface_residues')
cols=['#E45756' if s=='IFT56' else ('#4C78A8' if sb=='B1' else '#B0B7C3') for s,sb in zip(cc.subunit,cc.subcomplex)]
a.barh(cc.subunit,cc.interface_residues,color=cols)
a.set_xlabel('Interface residues buried inside the IFT-B repeat (heavy atom < 5 A, PDB 8BD7)')
a.set_title('IFT56 (red) buries 31 residues; the IFT-B1 median is 124')
a=ax[1]
a.plot(per.pos,per.frac_id.rolling(9,center=True,min_periods=1).mean(),color='#333',lw=1.1)
a.axvspan(325,574,color='#FFE9C7',alpha=.8,zorder=0)
a.text(450,1.05,'C-terminal half: conserved, pLDDT 91.9, zero IFT-B contacts',ha='center',fontsize=9)
for c,col,y in [('contact_IFT46','#4C78A8',0.97),('contact_IFT52','#54A24B',0.93),('contact_IFT70','#E45756',0.89)]:
    p=per.pos[per[c]]; a.scatter(p,[y]*len(p),s=30,marker='|',color=col,label=c.replace('contact_','binds '))
for nm,s,e in [('P1',45,62),('P2',166,373),('P3',347,357),('P4',378,414)]:
    a.annotate(nm,xy=((s+e)/2,0.06),fontsize=8,ha='center',color='#8B5A00')
    a.plot([s,e],[0.02,0.02],lw=3,color='#C98A00')
a.set_ylim(0,1.12); a.set_xlim(1,574)
a.set_xlabel('DYF-13 residue'); a.set_ylabel('fraction identical (10 orthologs)')
a.set_title('Transferred IFT-B contacts all lie before residue 324; the four conserved surface patches (P1-P4, orange) match none of them')
a.legend(fontsize=8,loc='center left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nFinal provenance files:",sorted(os.listdir(PROV)))
